_comment: Shown in the main menu (Credits). Third-party assets and their licences; keep in step with rldb/assets/CREDITS.md.

sections.title: RLDB
lines: Card art, table and menu backgrounds and the soundtrack: supplied by the RLDB team.
Sound effects: generated for RLDB with ElevenLabs Sound Effects (eleven_text_to_sound_v2), November 2026.

sections.title: Status icons
lines: From game-icons.net, licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 (CC BY 3.0, creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/).
Lorc: rune stone, anchor, ankh, broadhead arrow, hood, sprint, semi-closed eye, crossed chains, cracked shield.
Delapouite: sparkles. Zeromancer: heart plus. Carl Olsen: flame. Skoll: pentacle, sight disabled. Darkzaitzev: death juice.
Used unmodified as white glyphs, drawn on coloured tokens.

sections.title: Surface textures
lines: Leather032, Leather030, Wood051 and Metal009 from ambientCG.com, licensed under CC0 1.0.
Converted to grayscale relief maps for the UI (tools/godot/bake_ui_materials.gd).

sections.title: Fonts
lines: Cinzel (The Cinzel Project Authors) and Alegreya Sans (The Alegreya Sans Project Authors), under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.
RLDB Symbols, a subset of Noto Sans Symbols 2 (The Noto Project Authors), under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.

sections.title: Engine
